description: The text of one article (or point) as published by the Seimas Chancellery, unchanged, with its status today (Galioja šiandien / Įsigalios D / Gali būti pasenęs / Neaišku, ar galioja / Neteko galios), until when that label is certain, amending acts, the future wording if adopted, defined terms used, a citation line and the official e-tar.lt link.

act.description: Act key, abbreviation, TAR code or name: "DK", "CK", "KET", "2016-23709", "darbo kodeksas"

article.description: Article or point number: "52", "21¹" or "21-1", "6.228-1", "3.2" (also accepted as `n`); an annex: "6 priedas", "V priedas" (whether an annex is in force today is not checked: its status says so)

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: the text in force on that date (the Chancellery's official consolidation for it, since 2020, where the open data hold one); without it, today's text

find.description: Optional: only the paragraphs and table rows holding these words, e.g. a substance's name or CAS number in a long annex ("formaldehidas", "50-00-0")

offset.description: Optional: a very long text comes in pieces of about 60,000 characters; the answer's next_offset says where the next begins

part.description: Optional: one part of the article, by number or anchor ("107" or "d107"; a rule's sub-point "8.12" or "p8.12"): only that part's text (and its future wording) instead of the whole article

name: get_article
